summary: 100X.VC is an Indian early-stage fund that says it funds exceptional Indian founders with moonshot ideas and makes the first institutional cheque using founder-friendly India SAFE Notes. Its homepage reports more than 400 founders, 180 companies and more than $90,000,000 in follow-on funding raised by the portfolio. The About page describes a lean team of operators and investors. Cheque size, sector focus, an application route and a street address are not stated on the pages reviewed.

investmentEvidence.fact: The homepage states 180 companies funded and $90M+ follow-on funding; individual companies and dates are not listed on the pages reviewed.

sources.title: Homepage: India SAFE Notes, milestones and positioning
